mappedTo: Existing MATURE06-05 / REQ45 only; no newtask/claim/versionupgrade/runtime
skills: Previously discovered assistant-ui and clean-code; follow existing DictationAdapter instead of another composer or microphone state store.

findings.fact: The pinned built-in adapter only accepts language/continuous/interimResults. isSupported checks constructor presence only; listen creates its own recognition and starts it without processLocally. It cannot establish on-device-only operation from its existing options.
findings.basis: Read actual pinned speech.ts; no import/instantiation performed.

findings.fact: The official supported extension point remains DictationAdapter.Session with stop/cancel and unsubscribable callbacks; final versus interim results are represented explicitly.
processLocally defaults false, which lets the browser choose remote or local processing. Explicit true requires local processing.

available with processLocally true distinguishes available, downloading, downloadable and unavailable for requested languages. Policy can reject the check, and absent language packs prevent successful local start.

implementationInference: A future local-only feature needs a narrow custom DictationAdapter owning its recognition instance; a wrapper that merely probes builtin.isSupported and delegates builtin.listen is insufficient. Do not monkey-patch global SpeechRecognition or add a second mic/runtime.

Gate on actual required API and requested-language availability, set processLocally=true before start, and retain editable text when unsupported/unavailable/policy-denied. Language installation remains explicit user action; no automatic download or cloud fallback.

Keep one leased composer/session binding through stop/cancel/disposal, revoke late callbacks when plugin or pane changes, and let assistant-ui manage interim/final composer updates. No automatic send.
acceptanceProposal: Fake recognition verifies processLocally true before start and zero start for unsupported/missing pack/policy error.
Separate stop final result from cancel, suppress callback after dispose/pane switch/plugin revocation, unsubscribe each registered callback.
Actual browser API availability, Chinese pack/support, recognition quality and latency require future authorized user microphone action; documentation alone is no runtime proof.
priority: Low-priority existing research backlog; does not block current service restoration or Web ready candidates.
cleanCode: Small adapter plus capability result, explicit cleanup ownership and status semantics; avoid copying the whole upstream speech module or inventing a second composer.
